title: Correlated Gaussian measure
statement: For a natural number $n$ and real number $\\rho$, take two independent vectors $Z_1,Z_2\\in\\mathbb{R}^n$ whose coordinates are independent standard Gaussian random variables. The correlated Gaussian measure with parameter $\\rho$ is the distribution of $\\bigl(Z_1,\\,\\rho Z_1+\\sqrt{1-\\rho^2}Z_2\\bigr)$.
